verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer is a knowledge-worker agent service, so official mobile apps are a fair question for it. The evidence covers only the MCP server, the analytics API, web access via the perplexity.ai sidebar, and DGX Spark-based local hosting. Nothing in the pack documents official iOS or Android apps for Computer.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can use full-featured official mobile apps for iOS and Android
